pages.name: Coffee Bush
pages.text: A ripe Coffee Bush, covered in red coffee cherries.

pages.title: Growing
pages.text: A Coffee Bush grows like a sweet berry bush, through four stages:$(li)a small $(thing)starter bush$()$(li)a full $(thing)bush$()$(li)green, unripe $(thing)cherries$()$(li)$(thing)ripe$() red cherries$(br2)It needs light to grow, and bone meal speeds it up.

pages.title: Picking
pages.text: $(thing)Right-click$() a ripe bush to pick 1-3 $(item)Raw Coffee Beans$(). The bush stays and fruits again.$(br2)The beans' quality depends on the bush's $(l:caffeinecubed:basics/bean_quality)biome$(/l). Breaking a ripe bush drops beans too; younger bushes drop nothing.$(br2)Walking through it slows you down, but it has no thorns.
